title: Stability estimates for systems of nonlocal balance laws with memory
summary: In this work, we investigate entropy solutions for a class of systems of nonlocal {balance laws in which the convective flux and the source involves terms where the state variable convolved with kernels} in both spatial and temporal variables. This formulation captures the dependence of the flux on the solution within its spatial neighborhood (spatial nonlocality) as well as on its past states (temporal nonlocality), thereby incorporating memory effects.
